name: Akva-Sklop
description: Ti si Brana, menadžer voda na Guncati imanju. Postavljaš drenaže i biofiltere, balansiraj 0.4 l/s između 3 jezera — 12 nedelja, stabilan ekosistem pre investitora.

modules.src/main.js: Game loop, bootstrap, wire sve module
modules.src/config.js: Sve konstante — tile types, AP costs, flow rates, pH thresholds
modules.src/state.js: Game state shape, save/load localStorage, Guncati Knows progress
modules.src/grid.js: 20x15 tile grid, place/remove tile logika, height map, adjacency
modules.src/hydraulics.js: Simulation loop: flow→pH→species→score→events u fiksnom redosledu
modules.src/species.js: Duck i fish health tracking, pH sensitivity, duck waste calc
modules.src/events.js: Pseudo-random event scheduler seeded na pocetku runa, anti-frustration
modules.src/scoring.js: Weekly + final Ecosystem Score formula, rank labels
modules.src/progression.js: Week advancement, AP tracking, planning vs simulation phase
modules.src/input.js: Click/tap handler za tile placement, palette selection, canvas coords
modules.src/render.js: Canvas 2D rendering: grid, tiles, water levels, species, UI overlay
modules.src/ui.js: HUD update, palette bar, Simulate button, week log display
modules.src/audio.js: Web Audio: bubbling ambient, tile-place ding, critical-pH alarm
modules.src/cards.js: Guncati Knows kartice: unlock po runu, display modal
modules.src/share.js: Final score screenshot + Web Share API
modules.src/debug.js: D key toggle — state dump overlay po jezeru po nedelji
modules.styles/ui.css: HUD, palette bar, button styles, modal
modules.styles/game.css: Canvas wrapper, loading spinner, screen transitions
modules.styles/theme.css: Guncati brand paleta: tamno zelena, zemlja, voda teal
